   - Click on the "Processes" tab.
   - Click on the "CPU" column header to sort the processes by CPU usage.
   - Identify the top 5 processes consuming the most CPU resources.
   - Right-click on each process and select "End Task" to stop them.

   - Click on the "CPU" tab to view CPU usage.
   - Sort the processes by CPU usage by clicking on the "% CPU" column header.
